wiki.title: Eric Tilleman
wiki.extract: Eric Tilleman is an American politician serving as a member of the Montana House of Representatives. He represents the 23rd district which covers the southern area of Great Falls and nearby towns. He was appointed to the House in July 2024, succeeding Scot Kerns who resigned. He was elected to a full term in November 2024.
